1.content:
## MAIN multi-app dashboard (one board — not one board per app)

**How to use**
- `app = All` → monitor **everything**, detect problems fast
- `app = EIP` (or API / Payment) → **same board**, only **filter** — multi servers + logs + errors for that app
- **Do not** create separate EIP / API / Payment dashboards (avoids repetitive boards)

**Tag once:** services & hosts `app:eip` / `app:api` / `app:payment` (names should also contain EIP/API/Payment when possible).

**OS:** Windows CPU + Linux CPU + Memory on **this** board.

2.content: ## CRITICAL ALERTS & AI ROOT CAUSE (Davis — look here first)

3.title: Open problems (quick detect)
3.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| fieldsAdd title = event.title
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toString(title), $app) or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), $app)
| summarize open_problems = count()
| fields open_problems

4.title: Problems
4.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| fieldsAdd title = event.title
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toString(title), $app) or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), $app)
| fields timestamp, title, event.category, event.severity, event.status, affected_entity_ids
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 50

5.title: AI Root Cause (Davis)
5.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| fieldsAdd title = event.title
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toString(title), $app) or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), $app)
| fields timestamp, title, event.root_cause, event.severity, affected_entity_ids
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 25

6.title: Alert Summary
6.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| filter event.status == "ACTIVE"
| fieldsAdd title = event.title
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toString(title), $app) or contains(toString(affected_entity_ids), $app)
| summarize count = count(), by: { event.severity }
| sort count desc

7.content: ## APPLICATION PERFORMANCE (selected app — or All apps)

8.title: Requests
8.query:
timeseries requests = sum(dt.service.request.count), by: { dt.entity.service }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, requests, name

9.title: Errors
9.query:
timeseries errors = avg(dt.service.request.failure.count), by: { dt.entity.service }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, errors, name

10.title: Response Time
10.query:
timeseries rt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time), by: { dt.entity.service }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, rt, name

11.content: ## INFRASTRUCTURE — multi servers (Windows + Linux) for selected app

12.title: Servers / Hosts (multi)
12.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), mem = avg(dt.host.memory.usage), by: { dt.entity.host }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| fieldsAdd osType = entityAttr(dt.entity.host, "osType")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| summarize avg_cpu = avg(arrayAvg(cpu)), avg_mem = avg(arrayAvg(mem)), by: { name, osType }
| sort avg_cpu desc
| limit 50

13.title: Windows CPU
13.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by: { dt.entity.host }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| fieldsAdd osType = entityAttr(dt.entity.host, "osType")
| filter contains(toString(osType), "WIN") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "win")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, cpu, name

14.title: Linux CPU
14.query:
timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by: { dt.entity.host }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| fieldsAdd osType = entityAttr(dt.entity.host, "osType")
| filter contains(toString(osType), "LINUX") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "linux") or (isNull(osType) and not contains(toLowerCase(name), "win"))
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, cpu, name

15.title: Memory
15.query:
timeseries mem = avg(dt.host.memory.usage), by: { dt.entity.host }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, mem, name

16.content: ## LOGS & ERRORS (follow selected app — e.g. EIP shows EIP servers' errors)

17.title: Error Logs
17.query:
fetch logs
| filter loglevel == "ERROR" or matchesValue(status, "ERROR")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(content, $app) or contains(toString(dt.source_entity), $app) or contains(toUpperCase(toString(host.name)), toUpperCase($app))
| sort timestamp desc
| fields timestamp, loglevel, content, dt.source_entity, host.name
| limit 100

18.title: Exception Traces
18.query:
fetch logs
| filter matchesPhrase(content, "Exception") or matchesPhrase(content, "exception") or matchesPhrase(content, "Traceback")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(content, $app) or contains(toUpperCase(toString(host.name)), toUpperCase($app))
| sort timestamp desc
| fields timestamp, content, dt.source_entity, host.name
| limit 100

19.content: ## DATABASE & DEPENDENCIES (same filter — no second dashboard)

20.title: DB Connections
20.query:
timeseries conns = avg(dt.service.request.count), by: { dt.entity.service }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| filter contains(toLowerCase(name), "sql") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "db") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "jdbc") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "mongo") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "redis") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "postgres") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "mysql")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, conns, name

21.title: Queries
21.query:
timeseries qt = avg(dt.service.request.response_time), by: { dt.entity.service }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| filter contains(toLowerCase(name), "sql") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "db") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "jdbc") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "mongo") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "redis") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "postgres") or contains(toLowerCase(name), "mysql")
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, qt, name

22.title: External Services
22.query:
timeseries fails = avg(dt.service.request.failure.count), by: { dt.entity.service }
| fieldsAdd name = entityName(dt.entity.service)
| filter $app == "All" or contains(toUpperCase(name), toUpperCase($app))
| fields timeframe, interval, fails, name
